slots.question: Who holds local administrator rights, and are those groups defined in the IT directory?
Who may log on remotely (Remote Desktop Users), and are those groups defined in the IT directory?
Which remote administration listeners and remote control tools are on each host?
Which administration connections were seen, from which hosts and zones?
Through which jump or management hosts do administrators reach the system, and is there a gateway or privileged access tool in front of them?
